text:
Erin: opening deploy window 02:00 UTC for api/runtime/console/router. short plan + rollback triggers.

Ben: runtime v2.3.5 ready, pinned for canary. I'll run mem and latency smokes.

Carla: console migration `ui-mig-2026-04` needs canary-only index build first. plan: 5% -> 50% -> 100%. final step requires brief read-only.

Dave: router change adds `x-rw-route` header and new split logic. recommend regional stagger, 8-12m drain. I've pre-staged route configs.

Alice: flag note: `kv.eviction` toggle could evict user session caches. Ben confirm differences?

Ben: canaries have eviction off. prod still on. will watch cache-miss rate.

deploy-bot: preflight ok. lock window 02:00-02:45 UTC. canary 15m.

(Canary)

Ben: runtime 5% canary healthy, p50 unchanged.

Carla: console canary index build succeeded, no errors. rolling to 50%.

Dave: router eu-central applied first, saw short p95 bump ~90ms for 2m. holding 10m.

Erin: decision: hold global router until eu-central stable. runtime can continue to 50% but hold 100%. console pause at 50% until router green.

Ben: runtime rollback cmd: `redwood deploy rollback runtime --to v2.3.4`. I'll run if p50 +200ms sustained 5m.

Carla: console rollback requires `redwood console migrate rollback --to previous` with ~3m downtime.

Dave: router rollback plan ready; will revert edge configs if 5xx >0.5% or p95 delta >100ms sustained 5m.

deploy-bot: lock extended to 03:15 UTC if needed.

Erin: I'll update release notes and notify support. thanks team. :thumbsup:
